shots.content: Inside a dining room, a rectangular table stands between a sideboard and patio doors, with a window along one side. A woman in an emerald sweater at the sideboard-side window seat asks about the plan, a man in a charcoal blazer sits at the patio-side window seat, and a woman in a mustard blouse sits at the sideboard-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the patio-door end, looking lengthwise along the dining table toward the sideboard, with both window-side seats and the sideboard-end seat in frame.

shots.content: The man in a charcoal blazer leaves the patio-side window seat and exits the dining room, while the woman in an emerald sweater speaks.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in an emerald sweater answers.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the sideboard end, looking lengthwise along the dining table toward the patio doors, with both window-side seats and the sideboard-end seat in frame.
